TextView.android:text: 🔐 Privacy by design • Local-only • Encrypted at rest

GDPR & Australian Privacy Principles (APPs)

• Data minimisation: the app collects only profile, exercise and diet information needed for the requested features.

• Purpose limitation: information is used to calculate and display the user's personal health summary.

• Consent: the user must actively agree to local data storage before a profile can be created or updated.

• Right to Access: the My Data screen provides a consolidated view of the complete stored profile and health records.

• Right to Erasure: Delete My Data permanently removes the profile and all exercise/diet records from the device.

• Secure storage: sensitive profile and health values are encrypted using AES-GCM before persistence. The encryption key is protected by Android Keystore.

• Data sharing: the application does not request INTERNET permission and does not transmit health data to a server or third party.

• Privacy by design: internal activities are not exported, and user-controlled deletion is available from the Summary screen.

• User control: users can inspect their stored data, update their profile, or erase all stored data.

These controls are implemented as application-level privacy measures for this educational project; they do not represent legal advice or a claim of formal regulatory certification.
